COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Left knee pain for 2 months. Unable to
Fully extend knee. Suspected meniscal injury.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

Mild tendinosis involving the lateral insertional fibers of the quadriceps tendon, without tear. Mild proximal patellar tendinosis without tear.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 10 mm, within normal limits.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Regional musculature is within normal limits. Tiny Baker's cyst. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of discrete meniscal or ligament tear.
2. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tears.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Three-month history medial sided knee pain without specific injury. Pain worse with activity.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Small high-grade partial-thickness focal defect at the central weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness fissuring central inferior femoral trochlea with mild subchondral marrow edema. Patellar cartilage remains intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Mild medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2.	Small partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

In den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen, kein Knochenmarksödem, kein bone bruise. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB sowie HKB intakt. MCL sowie LCL intakt. Kein Anhalt für ein Tractus iliotibialis-Syndrom. Deutlicher Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Geringes inferopattelares, subkutanes Hämatom, ansonsten die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Fokaler vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt mit subchdonralem Ödem im posteromedialen Tibiaplateau. Extrusion des Innenmeniskus mit Lappenriss im Hinterhorn mit einerseits in den Gelenkraum sowie auf die Meniskussubstanz umgeschlagenem Flap (Serie 6/ Image 11). Minimal Flüssigkeit angrenzend an das MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenemeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt mit subchondralen Zysten an der superolateralen Patellafacette (Serie 4/ Image 10) sowie der lateralen Trochlea mit hier auch Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Patella- und Quadrizepssehne. 

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder. 

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss.

МР находка: Няма данни за ставен излив. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и структура. Не се изобразява костномозъчен едем.   Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е интактен. Предна кръстна връзка се представя с непроменен сигнален интензитет, задната кръстна връзка също е интактна и със запазена цялост. МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус – в задния му рог се вижда хиперинтензна лезия с кос ход, достигащща до артикулиращия хрущял ан тибията – стадий 3. Частична руптура и на предния рог на минискус в съчетание с менискусови кисти . Частична увреда и на заден рог на медиален менискус – стадий 2а. Нормално изобразяване на колатералните лигаменти, като латералния е изместен встрани от подлежащите менискусови кисти. Хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Нормално изобрлазяване на меките тъкани в лявата колянна става.Заключение: МР данни за увреда на латерален менискус с формиране на менискусови кисти. Частична увреда на заден рог на медиален менискус.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial knee pain. Positive medial meniscus testing. 
Comparison: [REDACTED]. 

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the right  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  Moderate knee joint effusion. No popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: High-grade radial tear at the posterior horn/root junction. Large degree of peripheral meniscal extrusion, with the meniscus projecting 5 mm beyond the tibial margin. There is also a horizontal tear of the meniscal body and oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  There is full-thickness cartilage loss involving the weightbearing portions of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau, with mild to moderate subchondral bone marrow edema. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Bowing of the ligament secondary to meniscal extrusion. 

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: Diffuse thinning of the patellar cartilage, with high-grade and small full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial patellar facet. There is also multifocal cartilage fissuring of the lateral patellar facet. Partial-thickness cartilage loss is noted in the central and medial aspect of the trochlea. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Complex tear of the medial meniscus, including radial tear at the posterior horn/root junction, with peripheral extrusion.

2. Moderate medial greater than patellofemoral compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Moderate knee joint effusion.

Findings:  No significant knee joint effusion. No interarticular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact menisci.  Normal appearance of the distal biceps femoris tendon, pes anserine tendons and popliteus tendon.  Mild soft tissue edema at the interface between the distal iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle suggestive of mild iliotibial band friction syndrome.  Patella alta (Modified Insall Salvati ratio of 2.2). Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline cartilage.  Conclusion:  Mild soft tissue edema at the interface between the distal iliotibial band and the lateral femoral condyle suggestive of mild iliotibial band friction syndrome.
